Here is a concise structure for a small open-source library README. Keep it scannable, as most users only read the first 50 lines!

## Essential Sections

```markdown
# 📦 Library Name

[Badge: Version, License, Build Status, Coverage]
[Link: Website] [Link: Docs] [Link: Issues]

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
pip install library-name
# or npm install library-name
```

```python
from library import MyClass
result = MyClass().do_something()
print(result)  # Output: Success
```

## ✨ Features

- Feature 1: Does X efficiently
- Feature 2: Handles edge case Y
- Feature 3: Integrates with Z

## 🛠 Installation

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.8+
- Node 16+

### Setup
```bash
git clone https://github.com/you/library.git
cd library
pip install -e .
```

## Best Practices

| Do ✅ | Don't ❌ |
|-------|----------|
| **Include badges** (GitHub Actions, Coverage) | **Wall of text** (no code) |
| **Show examples** (copy-paste ready) | **Vague descriptions** |
| **Link to docs** (external site) | **No installation method** |
| **Keep it short** (first 20 lines matter most) | **Too much info upfront** |
| **Use emojis** (adds visual hierarchy) | **No contribution guide** |

## Section Priority

| Section | Importance | Location |
|---------|------------|----------|
| **Title/Badges** | 🔴 Critical | Top (always) |
| **Quick Start** | 🔴 Critical | Top 20 lines |
| **Features** | 🟡 Important | After quick start |
| **Installation** | 🟡 Important | After quick start |
| **Examples** | 🟢 Helpful | Middle |
| **Contributing** | 🟢 Helpful | Bottom |

## Pro Tips

1. **Use code blocks** for all examples
2. **Keep examples runnable** (one command)
3. **Add troubleshooting** section for common issues
4. **Link to documentation** (don't duplicate)
5. **Add a changelog** if versioned

## Example Badge Setup

```markdown
[![PyPI version](https://badge.fury.io/py/library-name.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/library-name/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Tests](https://github.com/you/library/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/you/library/actions)
```

**TL;DR:** Title → Quick Start → Features → Installation → Examples → Contributing! 📚
